subject: Pilot demo — holding until CapEx committee and exec travel settle
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Carson <elliot.carson@midlandenergy.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot demo — proposed slots and pre-read

Hi Elliot —

Thanks again for the time on the call yesterday. Per our chat I pulled together a tight 45-minute pilot walkthrough so your team can see latency/throughput profiles and the dedicated/private deployment options that map to your security needs.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Apr 22, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Apr 23, 13:00–13:45
- Fri Apr 25, 08:30–09:15

Attached is a short overview (Redwood-Overview.pdf) and a one-page example of throughput we expect on a baseline workload. If those don’t work, tell me a range and we’ll adapt. Also attaching a draft estimate and a sample SOW we can tailor once we lock scope.

Action items: can you confirm who from Midland will join (security, procurement)? I’ll add a calendar invite and a brief runbook.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0173

Attachments: Redwood-Overview.pdf (10KB stub), MAL-quote-v2.pdf (pricing stub)
From: Elliot Carson <elliot.carson@midlandenergy.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@midlandenergy.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 13:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot demo — proposed slots and pre-read

Vanessa —

Appreciate the materials. Quick heads up: CFO is traveling through the 21st and we currently have a temporary CapEx hold while the finance team re-prioritizes projects for the remainder of the fiscal year. Our CapEx committee meets on Apr 24 to review outstanding pilots and budget requests.

Could we hold scheduling until after that meeting? If the committee greenlights a pilot, the earliest we’d be able to proceed is week of May 5. Can you send a one-page estimate that Procurement can use in the queue (budget code, line-item pricing, expected contract duration)? Procurement is looped here.

If you can target a May 5–9 pilot window as a placeholder, that will help — but right now I need to keep this paused until the committee decides.

Thanks,
Elliot Carson
Director, Engineering — Forecasting
Midland Energy
elliot.carson@midlandenergy.com | +1 212-555-0912

Folks — forwarding Elliot’s note. Key points: CapEx committee meets Apr 24, CFO travel through the 21st, procurement wants a one-page estimate for the budget queue. Please:

- Pause calendar sends to Midland for this week.
- Karthik: can you produce a condensed estimate (line items + budget code language) we can hand to procurement? Aim for a single page they can drop in the committee packet.
- Monica: prep an internal short-answer security note (how private deployment maps to their controls) in case the committee asks about data residency and KMS.

I attached a quick estimate draft (Midland-Estimate-v1.xlsx) and the earlier MAL quote for context. Mark this deal as prospect->on_hold (capex) in the tracker and add the Apr 24 review date as the next follow-up.

I’ll hold off on external outreach until we hear back. If the committee approves, Elliot suggested May 5–9 as the earliest run window.

Thanks —
Vanessa

Subject: Re: Pilot demo — proposed slots and pre-read (CapEx update)

Vanessa / Monica —

Quick update: the CapEx committee met yesterday and allocated a small pilot budget to evaluate two vendors. They asked that we run the pilot in the week of May 5 and supply Procurement with the one-page estimate and expected contract length (12 months preferred).

Proposed pilot days: May 7 or May 8 (we have a lighter on-site schedule those days). Can you confirm a 45-minute slot and provide any final pre-reads (SOW + runbook) by next Tuesday (Apr 29)? Procurement will start the queue if they have the one-pager by then.

If you can send a calendar hold for May 7, 10:00–10:45 ET while we finalize, that would be great.

Regards,
Elliot

Attachments requested: one-page estimate, SOW stub, runbook summary.
